mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand, measured by HOUST, leads to higher corporate earnings expectations and thus a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: Significant negative 20-day forward returns when HOUST growth exceeds +10% in two consecutive months without other supportive indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in employment, proxied by PAYEMS, reduces labor market uncertainty and boosts investor confidence, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Negative 60-day returns when PAYEMS growth exceeds +8% for three consecutive months with no decline in inflation.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in the CPIAUCSL inflation rate crosses above 2%, the S&P 500 anticipates a Fed rate pause, producing a negative 20-day forward return.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2% inflation with FEDFUNDS unchanged for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply-side weakness that raises risk premia, resulting in negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Consistently positive 5-day returns when INDPRO shows steady expansion (≥ +1%) over four consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both demand (HOUST) and financial conditions (FEDFUNDS < 4%) amplifies equity valuation expansion, yielding positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not statistically different from zero when HOUST up +5% and FEDFUNDS remains below 4% for the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment (UNRATE) above 4% triggers a risk-off cascade that drives negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns positive when UNRATE stays below 4% for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent tightening in monetary policy (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25%) over a 3-month window is associated with negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns, except during recessionary regimes.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS monthly change > +0.25% for three months
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises but GDP growth is negative for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with low consumer demand (HOUST < -2%) creates dual supply-demand pressure that produces negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Positive 5-day returns when INDPRO expands by > 1% while HOUST declines by < -3% over the prior month.
